name: BIOAQUA Vitamin C Facial Serum 30ml Hyaluronic Acid Essence Anti-Aging Moisturizing Face Skin Care
description:
BIOAQUA Vitamin C Facial Serum 30ml
Hyaluronic Acid | Anti-Aging | Moisturizing | Face Skin Care

Enriched with Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid, this facial serum deeply nourishes, repairs, and moisturizes your skin. Its gentle formula is suitable for both men and women, helping to restore a youthful glow and repair skin damage.

Key Benefits:

Deep Nourishment & Repair: Supplements skin nutrition, reverses damage, and restores radiance.

Skin Stability: Maintains healthy skin texture, prevents breakouts and blackheads, and keeps skin youthful.

Fast Absorption: Non-greasy, easily absorbed, and promotes skin tightening for a refreshed look.

Enhances Complexion: Balances skin tone and reveals a natural, radiant glow.

High-Quality Formula: Gentle, mild, and safe for all skin types.

Experience healthy, youthful, and radiant skin with BIOAQUA Vitamin C Facial Serum.

Country of Origin: China
